name: JoAi: Update Product Variation External Reference

description.en: Change the source or the external article ID of an existing product variation reference, for example when an item moves to a new POS system or gets a new supplier number. Only the fields you provide are changed. Use this to keep cross-system article links accurate without removing and re-adding them.
description.de: Ändere die Quelle oder die externe Artikel-ID einer bestehenden Referenz einer Produktvariante, zum Beispiel wenn ein Artikel in ein neues Kassensystem umzieht oder eine neue Lieferantennummer bekommt. Nur die angegebenen Felder werden geändert. So bleiben Artikelverknüpfungen zwischen Systemen korrekt, ohne sie zu entfernen und neu anzulegen.
description.es: Change the source or the external article ID of an existing product variation reference, for example when an item moves to a new POS system or gets a new supplier number. Only the fields you provide are changed. Use this to keep cross-system article links accurate without removing and re-adding them.

bot: Use this to change the source or external ID of an existing external reference on a product variation. Pass variationId and referenceId, then the new source and/or externalId. Omit a field to keep its current value. If the reference ID is unknown, look up the variation first.

description.en: The hash ID of the product variation.
description.es: The hash ID of the product variation.
description.fr: The hash ID of the product variation.
description.ro: The hash ID of the product variation.
description.it: The hash ID of the product variation.

inputs.bot: The product variation hash ID. List products first to find it.

description.en: The ID of the external reference to update.
